en: Black-and-white/sepia postcard view of a European old town street leading toward a tall medieval/early‑modern city gate tower with a clock, battlements, and a high, intricate spire. At the base of the tower is an archway through which the street passes. To the left is a timber‑framed house; to the right are several multi‑story townhouses with shops and inns at street level. Painted signage on one prominent building reads "Gasthaus zum Bären". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the cobbled street.
